title: AUDIT-7 Lane 7 slice A: formalise text-linked stray issues in code (521 open)
body: developing-today/code has 521 OPEN issues (AUDIT-7 Lane 7 census 2026-11-23, tracking #13874) that carry no epic/* or primary-parent/* label but reference another issue in the body. For each, one by one, read the issue and its comments in full (comments per_page=100, count-confirmed): if a comment claims the item for another AUDIT-7 lane, SKIP it (hard stop). Identify the referenced design/epic/parent; add labels stray-work + the matching epic/<slug> and primary-parent/<slug>; where the parent is an epic issue and the item is not already a sub-issue, add it via POST /issues/<parent>/sub_issues. If no appropriate parent exists, label stray/needs-parent instead and list it on #13874. Post per-batch progress on #13874.

payload.risk: low: label + sub-issue metadata only, no code changes, no closes
tests: readback via fleet gh api: parent sub_issues list contains child; child labels contain stray-work + primary-parent/*
